governing_bodies.name: ICMR-NIN 2020
governing_bodies.plain_english: The Indian Council of Medical Research sets daily energy requirements. We use this to calculate exactly how many grams of sugar a child of a specific age can safely consume based on their daily calorie needs.

governing_bodies.name: WHO 2015
governing_bodies.plain_english: The World Health Organization recommends that 'free sugars' (added sugars) should be less than 10% of your total daily energy intake. For a standard adult diet, that is roughly 50g (or 12 teaspoons) per day.

governing_bodies.name: FSSAI 2020
governing_bodies.plain_english: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India mandates how nutrition labels must be printed. We use their standard Reference Daily Allowance (RDA) of 50g of added sugar for adults to calculate your percentages.

10+.label: Age 10 and over
10+.warning: FSSAI/WHO standard RDA for adults (2000 kcal).

under-2.label: Under 2 years
under-2.warning: Added sugar and salt are not recommended under age 2.
